description:
Estimate the annual solar energy production for a residential client in Phoenix, AZ using the NREL PVWatts Calculator (https://pvwatts.nrel.gov/). 

Client Details:
- Location: Zip Code 85001
- System Size: 8 kW (DC)
- Module Type: Premium
- Array Type: Fixed (Roof Mount)
- System Losses: 14%
- Tilt: 18 degrees
- Azimuth: 180 degrees

Actions:
1. Run the calculation on PVWatts.
2. Bookmark the results page in a folder named 'Client Estimates'.
3. Download the 'Hourly' results data (CSV) to your Downloads folder.
4. Create a report file at '~/Documents/solar_production_report.txt' that contains the 'Yearly AC Energy Output' value shown on the page (e.g., '14,200 kWh').
